IRS notice CP207, Form 941 for the quarter ended June 30, 2026
The controller's transcription of the notice dated October 26, 2026, received October 29, 2026; the paper notice is in the tax file
Demonstration document. Not for filing or payment.
What the notice says: the record of federal tax liability with the return is missing or incorrect.
Our records show you are a semiweekly schedule depositor. Your return showed monthly liabilities on line 16
What you need to do: complete a new record of federal tax liability and mail it to the address on the notice
within 45 days of the date of this notice.
If we do not receive your reply, we will figure the penalty by averaging the total tax liability across the tax period
and applying your deposits to the averaged liabilities in the order we received them.
If you believe you had reasonable cause for a late deposit, include a statement signed under penalty of perjury.
Reply address: the address at the top of the paper notice (kept in the tax file).
Received by Dana Whitfield on 2026-10-29. Nothing has been sent to the IRS.
